Central Police Station.
October 4th, 191 6.
REPORT ON A Watch Kept on the Movements of Nielsen from the 25th
September to the 3rd October, 1916.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by
Sir,
Nielsen still lives at the German Club No. 4 Room. He keeps
a dispensary at No. 108 Chautoong Road, owns motor car No. 179
which he drives himself,and stores at the Central Garage. On
the 25th inst. he was not located. At 11.45 a.m. 26th inst. he
left the German Club and went to Astor House which he left at
2 p.m. and visited his dispensary. From there he visited
Rosenbaums No. 34 Kiangsi Road. Then returned car to the
Garage and went via Public Garden to Aster House where he stayed
the evening. At 9.30 a.m. 27th inst. left the Club and to
dispensary. At 10 a.m. visited Kalee until noon when he went
to ██████ German Consulate and then returned to Club until
3 p.m. when he got out his car and visited No. 1 Jessfield Road
returning to German Club at 6 p.m. and did not again come out.
About 10 a.m. 28th inst. left Club and visited his dispensary
and shortly left for 1 Jessfield Road. Returned to Club for
tiffin and at 3 p.m. visited Public Gardens returning at 5 p.m.
Did not leave Club that night. At 9.30 a.m. 29th inst. to
dispensary and from there to Astor House and to German Club
again returning to Astor House. At 4 p.m. to dispensary and
from there visited Dr. Fischer, 112 Szechuen Road. Then
returned to Dispensary where he met a thin faced German looking
man who accompanied him to the Astor House which he left,alone.
At 8 p.m. and motored round the Settlement during the evening.
At 9.30 a.m. to Dispensary which he left at 11 a.m. and visited
German Consulate and German Club. At 8 p.m. to Astor House
which he left in his car and visited the Kiangsu Chemical Works

刑事侦缉处
F. 658
1916年10月9日
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
中央捕房。
1916年10月4日。
关于1916年9月25日至10月3日期间对尼尔森（Nielsen）行踪进行监视的报告。
由副探长布鲁斯特（Brewster）撰写。呈报给
阁下，
尼尔森仍住在德国总会4号房间。他在兆通路（Chautoong Road）108号设有一间诊疗所，拥有一辆编号为179的汽车并亲自驾驶，车辆停放在中央车库。本月25日，未找到其踪迹。本月26日上午11时45分，他离开德国总会前往礼查饭店（Astor House），于下午2时离开并前往其诊疗所。随后他前往江西路34号的罗森鲍姆（Rosenbaums）处。之后将车还回车库，经外滩公园（Public Garden）前往礼查饭店，并在那里过夜。本月27日上午9时30分，离开总会前往诊疗所。上午10时前往卡利戏院（Kalee），直至中午前往██████德国领事馆，随后返回总会，直到下午3时取出汽车前往极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）1号，于下午6时返回德国总会，此后未再外出。本月28日上午10时许，离开总会前往其诊疗所，不久后前往极司菲尔路1号。返回总会用午餐，下午3时前往外滩公园，下午5时返回。当晚未离开总会。本月29日上午9时30分前往诊疗所，随后前往礼查饭店，又返回德国总会，再次回到礼查饭店。下午4时前往诊疗所，随后拜访了四川路112号的费希尔医生（Dr. Fischer）。然后返回诊疗所，在那里遇到一位面容瘦削、看似德国人的男子，该男子陪同他前往礼查饭店，但他独自离开。晚上8时驾车在租界内绕行。上午9时30分前往诊疗所，于上午11时离开，拜访了德国领事馆和德国总会。晚上8时前往礼查饭店，随后驾车离开，前往江苏化学工厂

which he left accompanied by a stout man with whom he drove
round the Settlements returning to the Club at 1 a.m. At 9
a.m. 1st inst to Dispensary. At 10.30 a.m. to 20 Nanking
Road. Then took car back to Dispensary and from there visited
112 Szechuen Road and to Club. At 1 p.m. took car to Kiangsu
Chemical Works returning to Astor at 3 p.m. and again to
Dispensary. At 7 p.m. motored round the Settlements alone.
At 9.30 a.m. 2nd inst to Dispensary and then visited Central
Garage, German Club, 20 Nanking Road, Ismer & Co., and back to
Dispensary. Then to 20 Nanking Road and Astor House which he
left at 3.15 p.m to 20 Nanking Road. Then motored round the
Settlement and back to Dispensary and to Astor House which he
left at 5.45 p.m. and motored round the Settlement alone. At
10 a.m. 3rd inst. to Dispensary and from there to 20 Nanking
Road and also No. 17 B from whence he took a roll of papers to
the Dispensary. At 12.30 p.m. to Astor House and to Garage
for car, picked up two well dressed Chinese at Dispensary and
drove them out by Jessfield and returned by Frenchtown.
Your obedient servant,
Detective Sub-Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.

报告
由 撰写 呈报给
他离开时由一名体格魁梧的男子陪同，二人驾车在租界内绕行，于凌晨1时返回总会。本月1日上午9时前往诊疗所。上午10时30分前往南京路20号。随后取车返回诊疗所，从那里前往四川路112号及总会。下午1时驾车前往江苏化学工厂，下午3时返回礼查饭店，又再次前往诊疗所。晚上7时独自在租界内驾车绕行。本月2日上午9时30分前往诊疗所，随后走访了中央车库、德国总会、南京路20号、伊斯默公司（Ismer & Co.），并返回诊疗所。然后前往南京路20号和礼查饭店，于下午3时15分离开前往南京路20号。随后在租界内驾车绕行，返回诊疗所及礼查饭店，于下午5时45分离开，独自在租界内驾车绕行。本月3日上午10时前往诊疗所，从那里前往南京路20号以及17号B座，并从那里取了一卷文件送往诊疗所。中午12时30分前往礼查饭店，去车库取车，在诊疗所接上两名衣着体面的中国人，经极司菲尔路将他们送出，后经法租界返回。
您顺从的仆人，
副探长。
首席探长。
